title: CI enforces rustfmt, clippy, cargo doc and a dependency audit
description:
There is no `rustfmt.toml`, no `clippy.toml`, and CI runs neither `cargo fmt --check` nor `cargo clippy`. `cargo fmt --all --check` currently reports 736 diff hunks, led by `crates/apricity-score/src/compile.rs` (118) and `dsl.rs` (112); 49 lines across the crates exceed 200 characters. No crate uses a crate-level lint attribute (`#![forbid(unsafe_code)]` would fit theory, score, data, engine and sources; the only match in sources is a word in an error string).

Done when: a `rustfmt.toml` records the house style (a wider `max_width` is acceptable), the workspace is formatted once, and CI runs `cargo fmt --all --check`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo doc --no-deps` and `cargo deny check` (or `cargo audit`) with `--locked`. `#![forbid(unsafe_code)]` is set on the crates that have no unsafe. A matching npm audit step for `web/` is included or filed separately.
